scope: B33–B36 are phased core proofs over existing workspace/Organ authority. B37 numerical participation stays deferred.
native_surfaces: Workspace create/open/publish/invite/redeem/revoke controls through existing native workspace management.
Entry card before detailed data: allowed profile, known/unknown sizes, cost, source logins, chosen cap and ready/adjusted/partial/refused state.
Independent navigation, source status, accepted receipt/history, recoverable draft and explicit reconnect reconciliation.
Optional presence/follow controls with visible opt-out; no implicit body, execution or desktop grant.

participants.credentials: Local only; never packaged or forwarded.

participants.principal: identified participant in its own device/Organ authentication context
participants.source_session: Own Organ B session when its restricted Sand is used.

participants.principal: explicit restricted public guest with bounded admission/session identity
participants.admission: Available only after the host explicitly enables a public projection; private invitations do not become public.

source_contexts.optional_unavailable_behavior: local partial/locked Sand; workspace remains usable

source_contexts.lifetime: independent subscription; leaving a hosted view cannot close another ordinary source consumer

disclosure.test_catalogue: The local Stage 01 manifest includes synthetic restricted assets for testing. It is never served as a public entry manifest or shared whole pack.
disclosure.fixture-public: Permitted public geometry/context/appearance and selected published fields.
disclosure.identified-editor: Separate restricted-interior.glb payload and its permitted fields; not part of visitor closure.
disclosure.host-private: Separate private-annotation.json sentinel payload; omit identity/hash/count/selector metadata from unauthorized projections.
disclosure.projection: Derive an authorized artifact/projection before transfer when a source blob mixes allowed and denied contents. A byte-identical cache hit does not grant access.
disclosure.public_cost_total: Only the permitted selected/published closure; hidden workspace totals remain unavailable rather than leaking private existence.
disclosure.revoke: Recheck admission/generation before serving or attaching new data; preserve only currently permitted cached viewing. Revocation does not claim to erase previously downloaded copies.

cost_card_fields.representation: known byte count or explicit unknown/partial coverage
exact allowed missing payload bytes plus separately measured metadata/retry overhead
selected offline pins, bounded cache and temporary/resume/replacement bytes
decoded/source/index/staging/old-new products across all active views; actual versus estimated labeled
selected asset/presence/source streams, cadence, cap, owner and persistent spent counter
required/optional capabilities, source login, local/host execution and explicit owner/payer
cheap capability/budget check; optional bounded trusted benchmark refines estimates without certifying arbitrary content

states.name: ready
states.meaning: Required granted closure and capabilities fit the admitted selected profile.

states.name: adjusted
states.meaning: A visible lower visual/coverage profile fits; accepted facts/physics/authority do not change.

states.name: partial
states.meaning: Useful required closure is available; optional appearance/source/detail is missing, denied or capped.

states.name: refused
states.meaning: Required granted capability/support/data cannot fit or be provided; state the concrete reason.

states.name: materializing
states.meaning: Admitted required products are in progress with bounded queues and useful coarse coverage where valid.

states.name: offline-draft
states.meaning: Permitted cached viewing and local draft remain usable; no automatic mutation replay or new source/host requests.

states.name: reconcile
states.meaning: Same authority returns; resolve recorded request outcomes and current grants/base before explicit draft reconciliation.

stream_classes.delivery: reliable bounded ordered acceptance/deltas; retain outcome identity
permission/generation checked, cancellable bounded ranges with verified artifact/transfer digests
replaceable coalesced samples, one pending sample/participant, max 10 Hz, 20 s expiry
registered here; selected bounded scientific observation starts at stage 17

steps: Stage 02: create/publish the tiny repeated document, invite/redeem the identified editor and explicitly admit a restricted public visitor.
Inspect bounded entry metadata and capability/cost states before requesting detailed payloads.
Stage 05: enter the exact B25 route on host/editor/visitor with independent detail/cameras; edit only through the common actor/base/receipt path.
Use both a cold cache and verified permitted cached payloads; compare additional bytes with the declared allowed closure.
Select a visitor cap smaller than an optional character payload but large enough for required coarse entry; show partial appearance and retain usable navigation.
Stage 06: repeat authorized offline/pinned closure and packed/directory transfer under the same loader and continuing counters.
hard: no full-world transfer to compute entry

phase_replays.native_action: Host publishes the tiny document, invites/redeems the editor and explicitly enables restricted public admission; both inspect the entry card before opening detail.
expected: editor is identified; guest never maps to trusted local authority
selected allowed closure, required/optional capability and known/unknown cost are visible
private invite does not enable public access

phase_replays.native_action: Editor and visitor enter B25 at independent detail; visitor selects a cap admitting required coarse entry but excluding optional appearance. Use cold and permitted warm caches.
expected: independent cameras and unchanged accepted dimensions
partial appearance remains navigable
additional bytes match authorized missing closure; quotas persist

phase_replays.native_action: Save the permitted route/profile, disconnect fully and move the authorized snapshot through packed/directory transfer with interrupted resume.
expected: required closure survives offline
mixed-rights pack is not disclosed whole
spent download counters survive resume

steps: Editor may inspect the separate restricted-interior payload; visitor gets only the public closure and cannot infer denied bounds/count/hash/index membership.
Deny both participants the host-private annotation through direct API, source reference, inspector/selector and whole-pack requests.
Open Organ B's public Sand, then its restricted Sand; authenticate only with that participant's own source session.
Revoke a source grant while a decode/transfer is pending; reject new usable delivery/late attachment without disabling unrelated public content.
Keep ordinary direct Protein usage working independently of the hosted view.
Exercise placement versus pixel versus remote-input grants separately for a supported Park surface; model viewing supplies none of the latter grants.
hard: participant/source/ceiling intersection at acceptance and delivery
no partial-view disclosure through a whole private blob
quality: clear original author/source and native next action

phase_replays.native_action: Try the same permitted and denied model edit as editor and visitor, plus host-private annotation lookup by direct reference.
expected: visitor edits denied
host-private annotation and existence metadata denied
current actor/role/ceiling checks precede acceptance

phase_replays.native_action: Query restricted-interior through inspector, selector, bounds and context pages, including a pending query whose grant is revoked.
expected: only identified permitted editor sees the interior
visitor learns no private counts/hashes/bounds/membership
late old-grant query cannot attach

phase_replays.native_action: Open public and restricted Organ B Sands as editor/visitor using each participant's own source session; leave the hosted view while a direct Protein consumer remains.
expected: host credentials are never borrowed
missing optional source is localized
direct Protein lifetime remains independent

phase_replays.native_action: Request the public selected closure from an archive containing restricted inputs and attempt an unauthorized whole-blob fetch.
expected: derive an authorized projection or refuse mixed blob
cached identical bytes do not grant access

phase_replays.native_action: Mount the supported Park panel, grant placement without pixels/input, then independently grant/revoke permitted capture and remote input.
expected: placement grants neither pixels nor input
current focused input owner and revoke are enforced

steps: Lose an accepted commit reply, reconnect and resolve the same request identity to its durable recorded outcome.
Change invitation/manifest/permission between estimate and entry; revalidate instead of retaining widened authority.
Revoke/regrant admission during pending transfer or job completion; old epochs cannot attach data or accept writes.
Interrupt host save/publication and restart; recover the last valid head and receipts, retaining the visitor/editor's permitted cache and local drafts.
Keep drafts inert until explicit reconciliation; do not replay model edits, Area crossings, Actions or worker starts.
Seed a partly spent cap, then disconnect/resume/change source; spent bytes are retained and global limits still bound new guest identities.
hard: no automatic writer election or compute donation
no quota reset or unintended public fallback

phase_replays.native_action: Lose the reply after durable acceptance, retry the same request, interrupt root publication and restart; change invitation/grant between estimate and entry.
expected: one durable outcome per request
recover complete last accepted root
drafts remain inert and admission is revalidated

phase_replays.native_action: Revoke/regrant admission with a transfer pending, exhaust a partly spent cap, lose/restart the host and reconcile explicitly.
expected: old epochs cannot attach data or accept writes
permitted cache and local draft remain usable
no mutation replay, physics election or participant compute donation

phase_replays.native_action: Resume the interrupted selected pack after reconnect/source change, attempting new guest admissions after the host-wide cap.
expected: spent counters do not reset
host-wide reservations bound aggregate new sessions
resume binds checked artifact/range and current grants

steps: Keep two distant close-up origins and independent navigation/selection while permitted source identity remains coherent.
Use optional cursor/avatar presence, opt out and expire disconnected samples; presence creates no accepted geometry/body/worker authority.
Run small native edits while a slow participant receives actual fixture assets and another viewer reverses demand.
Coalesce replaceable presence, preserve accepted deltas/receipts, and bound slow-reader reset/resnapshot without starving control.
Drag a shared preview faster than completion; accept only the exact current final input after base/scope checks.
Close one view then the last relevant view/session; shared demand survives the former and releases after the latter within the profile.
hard: display LOD never changes accepted facts or future physical state

phase_replays.native_action: Open distant close-up views, publish optional cursor/avatar samples, change origins independently, opt out and expire disconnected samples.
expected: correct permitted source/frame mapping
presence changes no accepted geometry/body
session sequence and expiry enforced

phase_replays.native_action: Change independent spatial/semantic interests while a narrow viewer queries shared selection context and loses a field grant.
expected: projection filtering precedes disclosure
bounded pages and fanout; no world scan
no stale target substitution

phase_replays.native_action: Edit native content while one participant receives fixture assets slowly and another reverses demand; close one view then the last.

only exact current final input commits
